saveError: Could not save settings. Check configuration permissions.
displayHelp: Minimal: tags and music. Hidden: no reserved space. Reopen with omarchy-shell dwm.bar.ui settings.
visibleHelp: Choose what appears in Full mode.
help.gameMode: Pause CPU/RAM and GPU readings and the visualizer until Game mode is turned off. Music and volume still work.
help.sleepAware: Skip GPU queries while the device is asleep so monitoring does not wake it.
help.showCpu: Show CPU utilization in the status line.
help.showRam: Show memory utilization in the status line.
help.showGpu: Show GPU utilization in the status line.
help.showVolume: Show volume and mute state, with click and scroll controls.
help.showTemperature: Show the GPU temperature and its warning state.
help.showMusic: Show the current track and the music-panel shortcut.
help.showIndicators: Show idle, night light, recording and notification controls.
help.showConnections: Show the native connection, audio, power and keyboard controls.
help.mode.full: Show all enabled widgets on this display.
help.mode.minimal: Show only workspace tags, music and settings on this display.
help.mode.hidden: Hide this display’s bar and release its reserved screen space.
help.showPlugins: Show configured plugin widgets such as Agents and monitor configuration in the corner group.
